sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Arrived on site; getting prepped for patrol.
Heading out on patrol, down towards Britomart.
Arrived at Q Convenience Store — the only open store at this time on the way down to Britomart. All clear with no issues.
Britomart McDonald's also all clear, no issues; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on TK Square and Commercial Bay.
Kowhai Coffee, TK Square and Commercial Bay all clear. The fence is still up in the middle of the square for the Christmas tree. Standing by for security presence at Lower Albert Street.
Received a call from McDonald's Queen Street; heading to assist with the call.

Arrived on site and was advised a male vagrant was sleeping on the couch and would not wake up. We were able to wake him after multiple attempts and he left in the end. Standing by for security presence. (Photo on file.)
77 Convenience Store and Mid City all clear; heading towards Aotea Square.
All clear, no issues; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check up on Elliott and Darby Street.
All clear on Elliott and Darby Street; heading back to charge the Ops Phone.
Heading back on patrol, up towards Victoria Street.
Welfare check on Woolworths Victoria Street and Chemist Warehouse, all clear; standing by for security presence.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street; commencing welfare checks.
Welfare check on the News Agency, Coffee Club, Roma Blooms, both 77 Convenience Stores, Amelia Cafe, Eighty Fed and V Phix Mobiles, no issues; standing by for security presence.

Arrived at St Patrick's Cathedral and completed a sweep, then was approached by one of the priests. Spoke for a while; he expressed thanks that we exist to help them when it comes to dealing with people. Standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart all clear; standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on Woolworths and Aotea Square; standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on Burger Fuel, Custom Mart, St Pierre's, 77 Convenience Store and Sol Hotel, all clear; checking up on Gore Street.
Welfare checks on Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart, Chargrill, King Made Noodles and the whole of Gore Street, no issues to report; standing by for security presence.
Welfare check, then heading towards Chancery Square:
Welfare check on Shortland Minimart and High Street through to Freyberg Square, then on to Chancery Square, no issues to report; standing by for security presence.
Sighted Paul with a can of alcohol; asked him to put it away and he complied. Unable to take a photo of him. Continuing patrol through Lorne Street.
Lorne Street all clear; heading back onto Queen Street, then down for one more patrol.
Arrived at the bottom of Queen Street. Welfare check from Acceco and NZ Muscle down towards OPSM, no issues to report.
Welfare check on Chemist Warehouse and QF Tavern, no issues to report; heading towards Vulcan Lane.
Vulcan Lane all clear; heading towards Britomart.

Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Customs Street, where a male member of the public notified us of two POI vagrants being aggressive and antisocial. Standing by for security presence. (Photos on file.)
Heading back to the office for a break.
Break completed; standing by for shift changeover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Afternoon Shift deployed; charging the Ops Phone before commencing patrols (14:45 charging).
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare checks on businesses from Mecca and Farmers down to BNZ and Van Cleef Arpels, all clear. Arrived at Britomart, commencing full sweep (15:10–15:27).
Full sweep of Britomart completed; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrols.
Customs Street West sweep completed; continuing patrols up Albert Street.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart, no issues.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street, no issues; arriving at St Patrick's Cathedral, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of St Patrick's Cathedral and Federal Square, all clear, no issues to report; continuing down Albert Street.
Arrived at Skymart Victoria Street; welfare check on staff completed, no issues. Standing by maintaining presence due to increased public activity.
Continuing patrols down Albert Street towards Wellesley Street.
Arrived at the top of Wellesley Street, standing by maintaining presence; then walking down Wellesley Street to conduct a welfare check on Elliott Stables.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; welfare check completed, no issues.
Metro Centre all clear, no issues; arriving at Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Commencing welfare check for Q Theatre.
Welfare check completed at Aotea Square and Q Theatre; continuing patrols.
Arriving at Lorne Street; commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Lorne Street completed, no issues to report; continuing patrols on High Street.
Full sweep of High Street, Vulcan Lane and Chancery Square, all clear, no issues to report.
Arriving at Fort Street; welfare check on Jo & Joes, all clear, no issues to report.
Gore Street sweep completed, Gore Street carpark all clear, no issues to report; heading to Commercial Bay via Customs Street.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay completed; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart completed, no issues. Standing by maintaining presence.
Continuing patrols, heading up Queen Street from Commercial Bay.
Received a response call from a member of the public walking around Mid City Queen Street who seemed frightened of a vagrant punching the air and yelling at people; heading over now.
Arrived at Mid City Queen Street; found the POI and asked him to keep his voice down and stop punching the air. He complied and walked off, no further issues; standing by maintaining presence.
Welfare check on upper Queen Street — McDonald's, Avachi, Hulucat, Mid City, 77 Convenience and Timezone centre — all clear, no issues; continuing up Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues; patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Lorne staircase mural, all clear, no issues identified; continuing down.
Full sweep of Lorne Street; patrolling down High Street.
Approached by a member of the public asking for directions to Celine's; provided directions to the location, no issues. Continuing down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep of the area (19:16–19:50).
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, Chancery Square, O'Connell Street and Chancery Street; welfare check on remaining open businesses in the area, all clear, no issues; continuing down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of the whole of High Street, all clear, no issues; continuing down Fort Lane.
Full sweep of Shortland Street; welfare check at Shortland Mart, Taco Bell and Haven Mart, all clear, no issues.

Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare check at Angus Steakhouse, Seoul Night, KFC, Vape Haven, The Right Track, Mr Murdochs and Snickel Lane, all clear, no issues; maintaining presence at Jo & Joes (20:20–20:34).
Welfare check at Jo & Joes, all clear, no issues; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (shown on the work camera) (20:46–21:25).
30-minute break completed; awaiting guard handover for the Night Shift.
Awaiting guard handover in the office.
Afternoon Shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Night Shift deployed; gearing up to commence patrols.
Full sweep of upper Queen Street; welfare check on McDonald's Queen Street and Avachi's, all clear, no issues; patrolling up Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear; patrolling down Albert Street.
Full sweep of the whole of Albert Street; welfare check at Skymart Convenience and Albert Mart, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues; arriving at Britomart.
Received a response call from The Right Track regarding a male individual inside the premises causing a disturbance to customers and smoking inside the store; en route to the location.
Arrived at the location; staff advised the individual had already fled the area — no damaged property and no customers hurt, all clear. Standing by for any further issues (23:20–23:35).
Welfare check at The Right Track, KFC and Jo & Joes, all clear, no issues to report; patrolling to High Street.
Full sweep of Shortland Street, no issues; patrolling up High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, no issues to report; continuing up High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep of the area while maintaining presence (00:02–00:45).
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, Chancery Street and O'Connell Street, all clear, no issues; continuing up High Street.
Full sweep of the whole of High Street, no issues to report.
Welfare check at the Lorne staircase mural centre, all clear, no issues; continuing patrols.
Full sweep of the whole of Lorne Street, no issues identified.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues; patrolling down Queen Street.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; standing by maintaining presence (01:20–01:45).
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, no issues identified; continuing down Queen Street.
Full sweep of the whole of Queen Street, no issues to report; arrived at Britomart, commencing sweep of the area (02:08–02:25).
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear, no issues to report; patrolling to Albert Street.
Customs Street West all clear, no issues; patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear, no issues to report.
Albert Street all clear, no issues; patrolling to Federal Square.
Swanson Street West all clear, no issues; arrived at Federal Square, commencing sweep of the area (02:54–03:45).
Full sweep of Federal Square, no issues to report; continuing down Wyndham Street.
Wyndham Street all clear, no issues to report; patrolling up Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear, no issues; patrolling Darby Street.
Darby Street all clear, no issues; commencing sweep at Elliott Street.
Full sweep of Elliott Street; welfare check at Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Victoria Street.
Full sweep of Victoria Street; patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear, no issues; patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, no issues to report; continuing down High Street.
High Street all clear, no issues; patrolling down Fort Lane.
Welfare check on Shortland Street, all clear, no issues.
Full welfare checks on Fort Lane, Jo & Joes and Wilson Carpark, all clear; patrolling to Britomart.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear; heading back to Headquarters.
Break completed; awaiting guard handover while remaining available for any calls.
Awaiting guard handover; no response calls.
Night Shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: STALE: 13:28 Public report of two aggressive/antisocial vagrants at Queen/Customs Street corner — team stood by for presence with photos on file, but no engagement or outcome is logged.
